hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1
M=refs/remotes/origin/main
select_main() {
  python3 -I -c '
import os, signal, subprocess, sys, time
deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
for _ in range(2):
    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
    if remaining <= 0:
        sys.exit(124)
    p = subprocess.Popen(
        ["git", "-c", "credential.interactive=never", "fetch", "--no-tags", "--no-prune", "--no-prune-tags",
         "--no-recurse-submodules", "--no-write-fetch-head", "--no-auto-maintenance", "--refmap=", "origin", "+refs/heads/main:" + sys.argv[1]],
        env=dict(os.environ, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0"), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        _, error = p.communicate(timeout=remaining)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        try:
            os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        p.wait()
        sys.exit(124)
    if p.returncode == 0 or b"cannot lock ref" not in error:
        sys.exit(p.returncode)
sys.exit(p.returncode)
' "$M" </dev/null 2>/dev/null
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && git rev-parse --verify "$M^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then return 0; fi
  cached=$(git rev-parse --short --verify "$M^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$status" in
    124) why='fetch timed out';;
    *) why='fetch failed or its result is unavailable';;
  esac
  printf 'remote freshness unknown (%s; cached origin/main: %s)' "$why" "${cached:-absent}"
  return 1
}
R=$(select_main)
fresh=$?
if [ "$fresh" -ne 0 ]; then
  printf '⚠ Session hooks: %s. Brief and SessionStart instruction log skipped. See AGENTS.md and docs/STATUS.md. · Manila %s\n' "$R" "$(TZ=Asia/Manila date '+%a %d %b %H:%M')"
  exit 0
fi
S=$(git show "$R:tools/instr_log.py" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$S" ] || ! REEF_HOOK_MAIN="$R" python3 -I -c "$S" >/dev/null; then
  printf '⚠ SessionStart: instruction logging unavailable on origin/main %.7s. Check hook diagnostics.\n' "$R"
fi
S=$(git show "$R:tools/brief.py" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$S" ] || ! printf '%s\n' "$S" | python3 -I - --short; then
  printf '⚠ SessionStart: short brief unavailable on origin/main %.7s. See AGENTS.md. · Manila %s\n' "$R" "$(TZ=Asia/Manila date '+%a %d %b %H:%M')"
fi
